subject: Metering incident: request to reconcile duplicate ledger entries
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Ruiz <tanya@ardensys.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Metering incident: request to reconcile duplicate ledger entries

Hi Tanya —

Thanks again for flagging the unexpected invoice increase for the June 14 billing period. Our incident team traced the root cause to a metering replay that caused a subset of sessions to be counted twice for a ~90-minute window. I know this touched a few of your production pipelines and produced duplicate token counts for several calls.

Quick summary of what we can do from Redwood's side:
- We will re-run the metering replay for your account, generate a corrected ledger, and propose an invoice adjustment.
- Pending your sign-off we'll apply a pro-rated credit on the next invoice and provide a line-item reconciliation.
- I’ve attached our internal replay log excerpt and a draft adjustment proposal so you can see the entries we believe are affected.

Could you please open the attached meter extract from your side (if you have one) and confirm which three job IDs below correspond to the high-volume traces you observed? That will help us validate the corrected counts against your logs:
- job_20270614_00123
- job_20270614_00127
- job_20270614_00189

I’m looping in Sean and Marissa from Billing so we can get a credits proposal out fast. We aim to have a reconciled ledger and credit proposal within 48 hours once you confirm the job IDs.

Apologies for the disruption — we understand this impacts forecasting. We’ll make the adjustment transparent in the portal and send the revised invoice with a supporting CSV.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice_20270614.pdf (PDF, 78KB); metering-replay-log-ard7421.csv (CSV, 120KB)

---

From: Tanya Ruiz <tanya@ardensys.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Arden Systems Ops <ops@ardensys.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:36:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Metering incident: request to reconcile duplicate ledger entries

Naomi,

Appreciate the quick reply. We pulled a local extract and attached our snippet (see ops_ard_snippet.csv). Confirmed the three job IDs you listed are the ones that spiked in our logs. For transparency, we saw the duplicate counts reflected in the following invoice lines:
- Customer API usage: line 42, qty 12,340 (expected ~6,150)
- Streamed completions: line 59, qty 3,860 (expected ~1,900)

We would like a credit to cover the duplicated portion and a short explanation we can send to finance. Ideally the credit posts to the June 30 invoice so our internal reconciliation matches.

Thanks,
Tanya Ruiz
Head of Platform Reliability
Arden Systems

Attachment: ops_ard_snippet.csv (CSV, 18KB)

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tanya Ruiz <tanya@ardensys.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Metering incident: request to reconcile duplicate ledger entries

Team — forwarding Arden’s confirmation (jobs confirmed). Action items I need from Billing/Finance:
1) Recompute a corrected ledger for ARD-7421 using the metering-replay-log-ard7421.csv attached to this thread. Prioritize matching the job IDs Tanya confirmed.
2) Draft a credit memo that will post against the June 30 invoice. Target amount = duplicated-token-value (line-item calc in adjustment_proposal_ARD-7421.xlsx).
3) Include a 1–2 sentence explanation for Arden finance that we can include in the portal credit note.

Timeline: Sean/Marissa — can you confirm whether this can be completed by EOD Monday (48-hour SLA from now)? If there are questions about scope, loop me in. Marcus, engineering will need to sign off on the corrected counts; please coordinate with infra to validate the replay output by Monday morning.

Naomi

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tanya Ruiz <tanya@ardensys.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Metering incident: request to reconcile duplicate ledger entries

Naomi / team / Tanya — quick update:
- We re-ran the reconciliation and validated against Arden’s ops_ard_snippet.csv. Engineering confirmed the three job IDs were double-counted during the 09:10–10:45 window on 2027-06-14.
- Proposed credit: $7,562.40 (pro-rated token refund). See attached adjustment_proposal_ARD-7421.xlsx for line-item math.
- Credit will post to the June 30 invoice and a credit memo (CM-ARD-7421-01) will be visible in the billing portal.

Tanya — we’ll publish a 1-line explanation: “Credit issued for duplicated metering counts caused by a brief replay incident on 2027-06-14; line-item adjustment attached.” If that wording is fine, we’ll post and close the loop.

Sean — please confirm when the portal memo is live so I can notify Arden. Marcus — ping if you see any discrepancy in the CSV match.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: adjustment_proposal_ARD-7421.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

---

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tanya Ruiz <tanya@ardensys.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Metering incident: request to reconcile duplicate ledger entries

Marissa — confirmed. Credit memo CM-ARD-7421-01 is posted to the portal and the revised invoice (INV-20270630-ARD-7421) will reflect the adjustment. I’ve also attached the public-facing one-line explanation to the memo.

Tanya — you should see the memo in the portal under Billing -> Credit Memos for Arden Systems. I’ll keep this thread open until you confirm receipt and that the numbers match your ledger.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
